name: The Thing
summary:
This project is a fan-made remake of The Thing, reimagined inside the original Max Payne engine, Max-FX.

The aim is to blend the atmospheric survival horror of John Carpenter’s iconic 1982 film with the gritty, noir-infused mechanics and visuals of Max Payne. Built entirely on the Max-FX framework, the remake leverages its detailed particle effects, real-time lighting, and scripted event system to recreate the paranoia, tension, and claustrophobic environments of an Antarctic research station under siege by a shape-shifting alien lifeform.

Players will experience a narrative-driven single-player campaign where exploration, environmental storytelling, and scripted scares replace Max Payne’s traditional urban gunfights. Combat will be sparse and deliberate, emphasizing resource management and the fear of not knowing who to trust. The mod will include newly modeled environments inspired by the film’s Outpost 31, custom character models and animations, dynamic weather effects.
